description: Displays a self-hosted SVG map with region selection, tooltips, panning, and zooming.

props.color: Fallback fill color for shapes without a fill in the SVG. Accepts a theme color or CSS color.
props.controls: Displays zoom and reset controls. Use the `controls` slot to customize their content.
props.disabled: Disables region selection, tooltips, and map navigation.
props.label: Accessible name of the map. Accepts plain text or a locale key.
props.maxZoom: Maximum magnification relative to the complete SVG viewBox.
props.minZoom: Minimum magnification. Values below one are treated as one.
props.modelValue: Identifier of the selected region. Activating the selected region clears the selection.
props.pan: Enables dragging and arrow-key panning within the SVG bounds.
props.readonly: Prevents selection changes while retaining navigation and region events.
props.regionColors: Maps region identifiers to theme colors or CSS fill colors.
props.regionLabels: Maps region identifiers to accessible labels and tooltip text.
props.selectedColor: Fill color of the selected region. Accepts a theme color or CSS color.
props.src: URL of a self-hosted SVG file. No default map service is contacted.
props.svg: Inline SVG markup. Takes precedence over **src**. Parsing runs after mounting in the browser.
props.tooltip: Displays the active region label in a tooltip. A `tooltip` slot also enables tooltips.
props.zoom: Magnification relative to the complete SVG viewBox. Supports `v-model:zoom`.
props.zoomable: Enables zoom buttons, mouse wheel, double click, pinch gestures, and zoom keyboard shortcuts.

slots.controls: Custom controls receiving the current zoom, `zoomIn`, `zoomOut`, and `reset` functions.
slots.default: Additional SVG content, such as markers, positioned in the source SVG coordinate system.
slots.error: Content shown when loading or parsing fails. Receives the error.
slots.loading: Content shown while the SVG source is loading.
slots.tooltip: Custom tooltip content receiving the region identifier, title, and selection state.

events.click:region: Emitted with the region and originating mouse or keyboard event when a region is activated.
events.error: Emitted when loading or parsing the SVG fails.
events.hover:region: Emitted with the active region on pointer hover or keyboard focus, or null when it leaves.
events.load: Emitted with the discovered regions after the current source has loaded.
events.update:modelValue: Emitted when the selected region changes.
events.update:zoom: Emitted when a navigation action changes magnification.

exposed.reset: Restores centered framing at the minimum zoom.
exposed.zoomIn: Increases zoom around the center of the current view.
exposed.zoomOut: Decreases zoom around the center of the current view.
